headline: Saraf and Partners advises IvyCap Ventures on Live2.ai $13 million pre-Series B fundraise
sum: Woovly India Private Limited, dba Live2.ai, has raised $13 million from a pre-Series B fundraise led by IvyCap Ventures. Saraf and Partners advised lead investor IvyCap Ventures on this fundraise.
detail: Woovly India Private Limited, dba Live2.ai, has raised $13 million from a pre-Series B fundraise led by IvyCap Ventures. Saraf and Partners advised lead investor IvyCap Ventures on this fundraise. The transaction team was led by Vivek Pareek (Partner) and comprised Associates Kevin Davis and Tarun Ashok. Vivek Pareek Live2.ai offers software and AI products enabling enterprises to streamline their marketing and social media management.
